summary: Comprehensive testing of Kolkata Metro App - Backend APIs 100% pass (24/24), Frontend UI mostly functional with minor navigation issues

ui_bugs.issue: Virtual metro card elements not rendering - virtual-metro-card, card-number, card-balance testIDs not visible despite 'Metro Card' title showing. API returns data correctly but UI components not displaying.
Profile user card and logout button not consistently visible. Works on first navigation but fails on subsequent navigations.
Chat screen not loading when clicking home-chat-btn. Chat title, input, and suggested prompts not visible.

integration_issues.issue: Station picker modal opens but station options (e.g., station-option-dum-dum) timeout on click. Modal interaction needs investigation.

issues: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'
Console warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'
Metro disconnection warning appears in console (not critical for production)

action_items: Fix Card tab: Ensure virtual card component renders correctly with balance and card number
Fix Profile tab: Investigate why profile-user-card visibility is inconsistent
Fix AI Chat navigation: Ensure chat screen loads when clicking home-chat-btn
Fix Route Finder modal: Make station options clickable in the picker modal
Add useEffect cleanup or navigation guards to reset modal states when switching tabs
Update deprecated React Native props (pointerEvents, shadow* to boxShadow)
critical_code_review_comments: Card Screen: Loading state returns early but main render may have timing issues with data fetching
Modal State Management: Modals in Tickets tab may persist state across tab navigation
Tab Navigation: Expo Router navigation may need explicit state reset between tab switches
All backend APIs working correctly - no backend issues found

success_rate.frontend: 70% (Login, Home, Route tab, Tickets tab, Tab navigation working. Card, Profile, Chat screens have rendering issues)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created test users and tickets. Admin account has Rs 870 balance, 4 favorite stations (Esplanade, Park Street, Howrah, Dum Dum), and multiple active tickets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully functional. Frontend has tab-specific rendering issues - Card, Profile, and Chat screens not loading correctly. Route finder modal interaction needs fixing. Core navigation (Home, Route, Tickets) works well. Issue appears to be related to component mounting/rendering timing or state management across tab navigation.

backend_test_details.auth_tests: 5/5 passed - Admin login, registration, duplicate email rejection, invalid credentials, get current user all working
backend_test_details.metro_data_tests: 6/6 passed - All 4 metro lines, 44 stations, route finding (Dum Dum to Park Street: Rs 15, 27 min, 10 stations), interchange detection working
backend_test_details.tickets_tests: 3/3 passed - Ticket booking with QR code generation, ticket retrieval, auth protection working
backend_test_details.metro_card_tests: 5/5 passed - Balance retrieval, top-up (Rs 685 → Rs 785), invalid amount rejection, transactions, card payment all working
backend_test_details.ai_chat_tests: 2/2 passed - Chat endpoint with GPT-4o-mini responding correctly, works with and without auth
backend_test_details.favorites_tests: 3/3 passed - Add, get, remove favorite stations working

working_features: Login page renders with all fields and Sign In button
Home screen loads with greeting, quick actions (4 buttons), metro lines (4 lines), popular routes
Tab navigation between Home, Route, Tickets works
Route tab loads with source/destination pickers
Tickets tab shows ticket list with QR codes
failing_features: Card tab: Virtual card not rendering (title shows but card elements missing)
Profile tab: User card not consistently visible
AI Chat: Screen not loading from home button
Route Finder: Station selection in modal times out
